表面应优先呈现玻璃质感，边框、阴影与模糊仅用于强化这一材质选择。

复制技法
渐变边框外壳
Use a thin gradient border shell around the main card. Wrap the surface in an outer shell with 0px padding and a 0px radius. Drive the shell with none so the edge reads like premium depth instead of a flat stroke. Keep the actual stroke understated so the gradient shell remains the hero edge treatment. Inset the real content surface inside the wrapper with a slightly smaller radius so the gradient only appears as a hairline frame.

规范与禁忌
遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。
建议
• 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。
• 间距需对齐检测到的 4px 节奏。
• 在卡片与控件上统一复用玻璃表面处理。
• keep corner radii within the detected 2px, 9999px family.
避免
• 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。
• 不要混用无关的阴影或模糊配方，以免破坏当前深度体系。
• 不要exceed the detected moderate motion intensity without a deliberate reason.
动效
动效克制且以界面为主导，贯穿文字、布局与区块过渡。 时序主要聚集在 10000ms 与 3000ms。 缓动偏好 Cubic 0, 0, 0.2, 1 与 Cubic 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1。 滚动编排采用 视差 控制区块显现与节奏。

WebGL
三维引擎 + WebGL
Reconstruct the graphics as a full-bleed background field using webgl, renderer, alpha, antialias. The effect should read as retro-futurist, technical, and atmospheric: dot-matrix particle field with green on black and sparse spacing. Build it from dot particles + soft depth fade so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow orbital drift. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift. Preserve dom fallback.

三维引擎
三维引擎 + WebGL
Reconstruct the 三维引擎 layer as a full-bleed background field 与层叠空间纵深 that feels retro-futurist, volumetric, and technical. Use alpha, antialias renderer settings, perspective, ~75deg fov, icosahedron + custom buffer geometry geometry, pointsmaterial + meshbasicmaterial materials, and 环境光 + 主光 + 轮廓光 lighting. Motion should read as slow orbital drift, with poster frame + dom fallback.
